output.summary: Edible succulent plant probably native to southern Africa. Its long ground-hugging stems root at their joints to form carpets, with fleshy pointed leaves and deep-magenta flowers. Leaves may be eaten raw, cooked or pickled; fruit should be fully ripe and may be laxative in large quantities.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are eaten raw, cooked or pickled; fully ripe fruit is edible but has little flesh and may be laxative in quantity.
